title: Add Yes/No interaction on final 'Will You Be My Valentine?' slide

requirements.text: Update the final carousel slide in `frontend/src/App.tsx` (the message with title "Will You Be My Valentine?") to render two CTA buttons: "Yes" and "No".

quotes: On the final slide of asking will you be my valentine? Add option yes or no.

acceptanceCriteria: When `currentMessageIndex` is on the last message (currently index 3), the UI shows both "Yes" and "No" buttons within the message card area.

requirements.text: Implement the "Yes" button behavior: when clicked, replace the question content on the final slide with a thank-you, loving message that includes the exact phrase "you are forever mine".

quotes: When yes is pressed display a thank you loving message, highlighting you are forever mine.

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking "Yes" displays a thank-you loving message on the final slide.
The displayed message includes the exact text: "you are forever mine".

requirements.text: Implement the "No" button behavior: when clicked, display a message stating there is no choice to select no, and then re-display only the "Yes" option (do not continue to show the "No" button after it is clicked).

quotes: When no is clicked display there is no choice to select no and display yes again

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking "No" displays an English message communicating that selecting "No" is not a real choice.
After clicking "No", the UI shows the "Yes" button again and does not show the "No" button.

constraints: Do not add new backend canister methods; `backend/main.mo` must remain unchanged unless strictly required for this UI-only interaction.
Do not edit files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (compose existing UI components like `Button` instead).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Persisting the Yes/No choice to the backend.
Adding new authentication flows or requiring Internet Identity login.
Adding new slides to the carousel or changing existing slide text outside the final-slide interaction.
